verdict.rationale: CSC is an entity-management and registered-agent SaaS that advertises AI features for document management, so asking whether customer data is excluded from model training is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or training exclusion. The AI feature description (csc-docs-18) is an adjacent feature and says nothing about training-data controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
